g1.flow: Four fa-kayfa kāna ʿadhābī wa nudhur, all inside the stories of peoples who denied. 1st closes Noah's story, after 'We left it as a sign'. 2nd opens ʿĀd, with kadhdhabat ʿĀdun in front. 3rd closes ʿĀd, after uprooted palm trunks. 4th closes Thamūd, after their companion hamstrung her. Hook: Noah once, ʿĀd twice (open and close), Thamūd once; Lot and Pharaoh get none.

cues.54:16: 1st, Noah's story: after 'We left it as a sign, is there any who will remember?'
cues.54:18: 2nd, opens ʿĀd: starts kadhdhabat ʿĀdun; the screaming wind follows.
cues.54:21: 3rd, closes ʿĀd: after people pulled out like uprooted palm trunks.
cues.54:30: 4th, Thamūd: after their companion dared and hamstrung her; next, one shriek.

g2.flow: Four wa laqad yassarnā l-Qurʾāna lidh-dhikr, each closing a story, and each time the next ayah names the next people who denied: ʿĀd, Thamūd, the people of Lot, the people of Pharaoh. The first two come straight after 'how were My punishment and warning'; the third after one shriek; the fourth after 'so taste My punishment'. Hook: ʿĀd, Thamūd, Lot, Pharaoh.

cues.54:17: 1st, ends Noah: after the first 'how were My punishment'; next, ʿĀd denied.
cues.54:22: 2nd, ends ʿĀd: after ʿĀd's closing 'how were My punishment'; next, Thamūd denied.
cues.54:32: 3rd, ends Thamūd: after one shriek, like dry twigs of a pen; next, Lot's people.
cues.54:40: 4th, ends Lot: after 'so taste My punishment and warning'; next, Pharaoh's people.

g3.flow: All open inna l-muttaqīna fī, then split. Al-Ḥijr and Adh-Dhāriyāt: jannātin wa ʿuyūn (springs). Aṭ-Ṭūr: jannātin wa naʿīm (pleasure). Al-Qamar: jannātin wa nahar (rivers). Al-Mursalāt: ẓilālin wa ʿuyūn (shades). Hook for Al-Qamar: its ayat end on r, like nudhur and muddakir, so here it is nahar, after 'every small and great thing is inscribed'.

cues.15:45: Al-Ḥijr: jannātin wa ʿuyūn, after Hell's seven gates; next, 'enter it in peace'.
cues.51:15: Adh-Dhāriyāt: jannātin wa ʿuyūn, after 'taste your torment'; next, accepting what their Lord gives.
cues.52:17: Aṭ-Ṭūr: jannātin wa naʿīm (pleasure), after 'burn therein, patient or impatient'.
cues.54:54: Al-Qamar: jannātin wa nahar (rivers), rhymes with nudhur; after every small and great thing inscribed.
cues.77:41: Al-Mursalāt: ẓilālin wa ʿuyūn (shades, not gardens), right after a woe to the deniers.
